title: PyPSA-Eur extension for CDR credit pricing: master thesis model and code
access_conditions: Code and data accompany an MSc thesis at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). Access is granted on request to the authors until the thesis is published.
description:
Master Thesis Fork — Felicia & Philipp, DTU, 2026

A modified version of PyPSA-Eur used for our Master's thesis at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), extended to investigate Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) technologies and their role in the European energy system transition. Contributions include an optimisation-layer CDR credit accounting framework, spatially-resolved CO₂ sequestration economics, direct-air-capture enhancements, and the supply-curve scenario analysis that produces the thesis results.

Every thesis contribution is mapped to the exact code that implements it in CONTRIBUTIONS.md, distinguishing our additions from upstream PyPSA-Eur. For the original model, see PyPSA/pypsa-eur.
